hexe.title: Project Hexe
hexe.summary: A web app designed and built end to end — wireframed in Figma, then brought to life in React with GSAP-driven motion.

sections.heading: The brief
sections.text: Turn a rough idea into a product people actually enjoy using: fast, clear, and with enough personality to be remembered.

sections.heading: The process
sections.text: Flows and low-fidelity wireframes first, tested on friends, then a small component library in Figma before a single line of React was written.

sections.heading: The outcome
sections.text: A responsive app built from a handful of reusable components, with motion that explains what changed instead of decorating it.

portfolio.title: This portfolio
portfolio.summary: A portfolio you move through like a map — five panels around a hub, one strict visual system, and every word ready for translation.

sections.heading: The brief
sections.text: Show a wide mix of work — code, design, photo and video — without it turning into one long, generic scroll.

sections.heading: The process
sections.text: Designed in Figma first. The panels sit on a grid and are reached with arrows, keys, the wheel or a swipe; GSAP handles the pans, the reveals and the intro. One set of rules — ink bands, hairlines and a single accent colour — keeps every panel related.

sections.heading: The outcome
sections.text: A fast static site on GitHub Pages that works with a keyboard, a mouse or a thumb, with all of its text kept in one JSON file so a new language is a single file away.

northline.title: Northline
northline.summary: A visual identity for a small outdoor brand — logo, type, colour and a set of templates that keep it consistent.

sections.heading: The brief
sections.text: A young brand with a good product and no face. It needed a mark that works as small as a sticker and as large as a banner.

sections.heading: The process
sections.text: Dozens of sketches narrowed down to three directions, each tested on real applications — packaging, social posts, a shop sign — before choosing one.

sections.heading: The outcome
sections.text: A compact identity system: primary and secondary marks, two typefaces, a four-colour palette and ready-to-use templates for the team.

fieldNotes.title: Field Notes
fieldNotes.summary: A photo series about ordinary places, shot over a year and edited to one quiet, consistent look.

sections.heading: The brief
sections.text: A personal project: find something worth looking at in places people walk past every day.

sections.heading: The process
sections.text: One camera, one lens and a rule of a single walk per week. The edit was built as a Lightroom preset early on so every frame belongs to the same set.

sections.heading: The outcome
sections.text: A tight selection of images out of thousands of frames — and a much better eye for light, timing and what to leave out.

afterglow.title: Afterglow
afterglow.summary: A short film edit — pacing, sound and a colour grade built around late evening light.

sections.heading: The brief
sections.text: Turn a few hours of loosely shot footage into a short piece with a clear mood and rhythm.

sections.heading: The process
sections.text: A rough cut to music, then a tighter cut to picture. The grade was matched shot by shot in DaVinci Resolve to hold the same warm evening tone.

sections.heading: The outcome
sections.text: A short, finished film with consistent colour and pacing — and a reusable grading setup for the next one.
